selection: first row matching kind and tp_min_seconds <= Tp < tp_max_seconds; null maximum is unbounded
normalization: discrete sum E df dtheta equals Hs^2/16 per partition; theta is TOWARD CCW from east
limitations: Bulk Hs/Tp/Dp cannot determine spectral width or multimodality within one partition. These shapes are reconstruction priors, not measured station spectra.
The 16 s threshold is an explicit engineering proxy for long-travel swell, not a published period-to-travel-distance law. Published s values describe short and long decay distance.
The published wind-sea JONSWAP shape is retained as a transparent swell frequency-shape prior because bulk partitions provide no peak-width observation.
s is the peak spreading parameter held across the reconstructed partition under SPEC v1. The frequency-dependent Mitsuyasu exponents +5 and -2.5 are not silently imposed by this table.
